title: padus virginiana
intro: Padus virginiana, commonly known as American Dogwood or Chokeberry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to eastern North America. The health benefits of Padus virginiana include its ability to support heart health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a diuretic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Padus virginiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
